title: Greenside, a family-friendly spot with a kids' play structure, is coming to Memorial City
summary: A new 35,000-square-foot outdoor-focused development at 1085 Gessner is set to open this fall, with a children's play structure in the design. Early tenants include Honest Mary's, Leemoo, Hiatus Spa and Solidcore, with more to be announced.
story: Memorial City is getting a new hangout built with families in mind. Greenside, a 35,000-square-foot development at 1085 Gessner, is set to open this fall. It's designed around the outdoors, and the plans include a children's play structure, so it could become an easy spot for a coffee or a bite while the kids climb.

The first tenants announced are the fast-casual restaurant Honest Mary's, Leemoo for health food, Hiatus Spa and a Solidcore fitness studio, with more to come. We'll keep an eye on the opening date and share it here as soon as it's set.

title: Memorial Park's new Camp Logan Playground is under construction
summary: Part of the 100-acre Memorial Groves project, the new playground will have giant helmets, army crates and even a huge loaf of bread to climb, inspired by the park's WWI history. A visitor center, restrooms and trails are coming too. Completion is targeted for late 2027.

title: Heads-up: library storytimes can be canceled on short notice
summary: Spring Branch Memorial Library canceled its Thursday Tiny Tykes storytime on Oct 22 because of staffing. Before you pack everyone into the car, check the library's online calendar the morning of.
